description: Land Acquisition - Supplements 58 and 12 in Topo PP17, Supplement 06 in Topo PP 535 of Thalagoda, Naula D/S Division, Matara District - Amendment to the Notice Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1861/33 of 08.05.2014 by R.D.A.
reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific lands being acquired by the government for the Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project, including detailed descriptions of land lots, names, types, claimants, and extents. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" which is explicitly covered by Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters.
